name: outputty
description: Claude Code plugin that carries an idea to a merged PR through GitHub Issues: /grill interviews, /breakdown files sub-issues, a build session runs /goal and dispatches one fix-issue agent per sub-issue, each opening its own stacked PR. Needs gh and gh stack.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Six skills (grill, breakdown, fix-issue, retro, github, init), one Sonnet fix-issue agent with the Fable advisor, and the templates a repo needs: a managed CLAUDE.md block, .claude/rules, an issue template whose done-conditions /goal judges, a PR template, and settings. Tasks are GitHub Issues managed with gh; the build loop is /goal; review is /code-review.
